g.text: Graph revision AD - nozzle_orient: 17 scheduled interfaces of docs-authority/nozzles/CRYO_ASU.csv at tag, face, height and bore; 16 drawn rows, 3 of them solids
Graph revision AD - nozzle_orient: N1-N4 (z 400) and N5-N8 (z 1500) distributed across the beds in tag order, second row per bed offset 130 mm
Graph revision AD - nozzle_orient: N11-N16 (z 160) are frame-level rows through the plinth: the datum sits below the bed shells; N13/N14/N15 are solids rows at DN15, bore not calculated
Graph revision AD - nozzle_orient: N9 drain beside the bed 1 pedestal, tip at the 50 datum; N10 vent standpipe on bed 1 to the 2000 datum
Graph revision AD - nozzle_orient: N17 (top, z 800) is the cable power terminal (cable schedule X-ELS-06): electrical, not piped - carried verbatim, not drawn
Graph revision AD - nozzle_orient: Atmospheric per the API 2000 relief basis; schedule rating column (Class 150) carried verbatim as text - per-tag positions in check.nozzles_drawn
Type: fabrication drawing (GA / nozzle orientation / part sheet) Rev 784c2321 Issued 2026-10-15
